notes: Added 2026-10-09 (the Liefwarrior three-role session). The ward's counters that sell a docker's things and the one that buys them back, on the gazetteer's own sites and the notables already bound to them: K08 Brann's Chandlery, K28 the Slop-Chest, K15 Fenner's Pawn.

PLACEHOLDER STOCK AND RATE, flagged for the owner: each counter's shelf is read off its gazetteer line (ship stores -- lamp oil, cordage; sailors' clothing; a pawnbroker's shelf of what was never redeemed), and Fenner paying half of a thing's worth is a number nobody has ruled on.

Prices are each item's authored royals (items.json) through the counter's guild term -- no second price list. Stock is the COUNTER's, never the keeper's body (DECISIONS 2026-09-12: a ward body carries nothing). Unlimited in this first version.
Every keeper must be a notables.json id and every item an items.json id; a row naming anything else is dropped at load, by name.
